description: Schema-v1 loved track (ADR 0005 §6.3, B12, B13). This ID is fixture-only; production requires an owner-controlled prefix.

main.description: The author loves one track. The server writer keeps at most one love per (artist key, track key) per DID; unlove deletes every matching love record. Loves written by other apps are indexed with the same proof rules.

artist.description: Raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; the scrobble limits, enforced by the validator.

track.description: Raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

album.description: If present, raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

recordingMbid.description: Optional unverified recording UUID; runtime validates UUID syntax.

createdAt.description: Explicit UTC RFC3339, from 1970-01-01 through event receipt time plus 300 seconds inclusive.
